jython:import re
value = re.sub(r'\s{2,}', '', value)

if len(re.findall(r'\w+', value)) > 8:
    return value
else:
    return "UNKNOWN"

This Python expression will standardize the location name representations to a consistent format by removing extra spaces and underscores/dashes, then check if the number of words in the location name is more than 8. If it is, the original location name is returned; otherwise, "UNKNOWN" is returned.
